clips.caption:
Being great at something is not the same as knowing how to win.

Kevin Trudeau points to Michael Jordan: you don't bet against him, you give him the ball. He says Tom Brady was clearly not the best thrower in league history, but he knew how to win.

Other people may be great players and still never learn it. Kevin says that intangible quality, along with a drive to work, is what to look for in a person.

Which matters more to you, raw talent or knowing how to win?
